Geodesic area of polygons

Source: R/domain.R
geodesic_area_km2.Rd

Area of polygons in geographic coordinates on the WGS84 ellipsoid, computed by lwgeom::st_geod_area(). This is the computation behind the cell areas of the ICCAT grid in Experimento 02 (sf::st_area() with spherical geometry switched off delegates to lwgeom), and it is used by every domain constructor of the package.

Usage

geodesic_area_km2(x)

Arguments

x

An sf or sfc object with polygons in longitude / latitude.

Value

Numeric vector of areas in km2.

Examples

cell <- sf::st_sfc(sf::st_polygon(list(cbind(c(0, 1, 1, 0, 0),
                                             c(0, 0, 1, 1, 0)))),
                   crs = 4326)
geodesic_area_km2(cell)   # 1x1 degree cell at the equator
#> [1] 12308.78
